“Done, looks like” is in your DELEGATION: A small amount of combined effort to draw up a plan of how and why to do something is leverage when it can be given to someone else, or an a.i. agent.

FLOW: You can actually give your full attention to the moment, in the moment. If a process becomes a worry or burden the smart decision is to kill it, pause, and then think BIGGER!

“Done, looks like” is in your DELEGATION: A small amount of combined effort to draw up a plan of how and why to do something is leverage when it can be given to someone else, or an a.i. agent.

FLOW: You can actually give your full attention to the moment, in the moment. If a process becomes a worry or burden the smart decision is to kill it, pause, and then think BIGGER!

You have neutral moments many times per day that you don't have a plan for how to react. You want a plan. Done, looks like you knowing what to do, and doing it because the alternative to getting yourself back in flow is such a useless alternative.
